pages.text: Climb four tiers. Each one unlocks new dimensions, materials, crafting systems, and magic — and tiers are $(bold)per-player$(), so each person on a server advances independently.$(br2)You advance by feeding the $(bold)Iridescent Codex$() token economy — see $(l:icraft:progression/tier_gates)How You Advance$(/l). A boss's tier comes from $(italic)where it generates$(), not how hard it hits.

pages.title: Tier 1 — Foundations
pages.text: $(bold)Material tier:$() Iron, Copper, Brass, Tin, Bronze$(br)$(bold)Dimensions:$() Overworld only$(br)$(bold)Tech:$() Create$(br)$(bold)Magic:$() Botania, Iron's Spells$(br)$(bold)Notable:$() Diamonds are not available in Overworld chests or worldgen. This is intentional. Apotheosis affixes are Common-tier only.

pages.title: Tier 2 — Expansion
pages.text: $(bold)Material tier:$() Steel, Manasteel, Steeleaf, Ironwood, Fiery$(br)$(bold)Dimensions:$() Twilight Forest, Blue Skies, The Aether$(br)$(bold)Tech:$() Thermal Series, Industrial Foregoing (basic)$(br)$(bold)Magic:$() Ars Nouveau$(br)$(bold)Notable:$() First Simply Swords uniques drop from Twilight bosses. Diamonds remain Tier 3.

pages.title: Tier 3 — Dominion
pages.text: $(bold)Material tier:$() Diamond (full), Terrasteel, Enderium, Osmium$(br)$(bold)Dimensions:$() Undergarden, Deeper & Darker, The Nether, The Abyss$(br)$(bold)Tech:$() Mekanism (basic), Refined Storage, IF (advanced)$(br)$(bold)Magic:$() Occultism, Forbidden & Arcanus$(br)$(bold)Notable:$() Ancient Debris accessible. The Nether unlocks here, not at game start.

pages.title: Tier 4 — Ascension
pages.text: $(bold)Material tier:$() Netherite, Gaia Ingots, Antimatter, Atomic Alloy$(br)$(bold)Dimensions:$() Deep Aether, The End (multi-zone)$(br)$(bold)Tech:$() Mekanism (advanced), RFTools Dimensions$(br)$(bold)Magic:$() Mahou Tsukai$(br)$(bold)Notable:$() The top of the ladder. Defeating the Ender Dragon is the finale and opens the post-game.
